_note: SYNTHETIC demo data written by ZapSight to illustrate combining field history with the manuals. Not real Fresenius service records. Sites, serials and technicians are invented.

cases.symptom: Blood pump module shows A.11, pump will not reach set speed at 300 ml/min
cases.fix: Replaced rotor Hall sensor, ran blood pump calibration check, 30 min test run without alarm

cases.symptom: A.11 returned two days after the rotor Hall sensor was replaced on a previous visit
cases.root_cause: Intermittent LP955 board connector; Hall sensor was not the fault
cases.fix: Reseated then replaced LP955 blood pump control board; alarm cleared and did not return in 2 weeks

cases.symptom: A.11 intermittent, worse when module is warm; new Hall sensor fitted last month
cases.fix: Replaced LP955; verified pump speed across range

cases.symptom: A.11 after Hall sensor and LP955 both checked good
E.07 on blood pump at power-up, clears only with power cycle
cases.root_cause: 20 pin ribbon cable from machine partly unseated after a previous repair
cases.fix: Measured +12V at 12.1 V (in range), reseated 20 pin ribbon cable, E.07 cleared

cases.symptom: No Water message during prime, heater off
cases.root_cause: Inlet water pressure regulator set low (14 psi peak)
cases.fix: Adjusted inlet pressure regulator to 19 psi peak per PM procedure

cases.symptom: No Water on three machines in the same bay at start of shift
cases.root_cause: Site RO feed pressure low, not a machine fault
cases.fix: Escalated to site water team; machines fine once feed restored
Cleaned flow path, recalibrated, test run OK

cases.symptom: Power failure alarm weak during annual PM
cases.root_cause: 9 V alkaline battery below 7 V under load
cases.fix: Replaced 9 V battery, power failure alarm test passed

cases.symptom: Conductivity on display differs from external meter by 0.3 mS/cm at annual PM
cases.fix: Recalibrated conductivity; within 0.1 mS/cm of external meter

cases.symptom: UF volume error, buret reading 1.25 after 24 strokes
cases.root_cause: UF pump volume out of adjustment
cases.fix: Adjusted UF pump volume screw until buret read 0.95-1.05

cases.symptom: Fill Program Alarm with blood sensed, recurring
cases.root_cause: Deaeration pump worn, air not cleared from air separation chamber
cases.fix: Replaced deaeration motor brushes, deaeration calibration

cases.symptom: A.13 blood pump turning the wrong way after module swap
cases.root_cause: Rotor Hall sensor wiring reversed on replacement module

cases.symptom: Air Detector Alarm on 2008K2 with chamber about three quarters full
cases.fix: Cleaned sensors with alcohol pad, reseated chamber below detection sensors

cases.symptom: Air Detector Alarm, level detector door not latching
cases.fix: Replaced door latch; alarm test passed

cases.symptom: Actuator BD no Echo at power-up
cases.fix: Power cycle did not clear; replaced actuator board

cases.symptom: Fail 9 Volt Battery during alarm tests
